text: Complaints over the inclusion of Young Palestinians Speak: Living Under Occupation in an Arab American Heritage Month display led to the book being removed from student access in a middle school library in April 2024. The book has since been moved to the high school, effectively banning it from middle school students in the district.
meta_description: Young Palestinians Speak: Living Under Occupation was removed from student access in a middle school library in April 2024 after complaints.
changes: Reordered complaint and removal; added 'effectively banning' from the source.
